SwapDef.description: What a block of the piece may become (a barrel a chest): a rule per state of the block in the template.

chance.description: How often it becomes that block (0.5: half the time).
chance.title: Chance

keep.description: Properties the new block takes over from the block it replaces (facing, waterlogged); the new block must have them.
keep.title: Keep

to.description: The block state it becomes, as the template has it (unturned): the game turns it with the piece.
to.title: To

SwapDef.title: SwapDef

VariantsDef.description: How one build gives several pieces: mirroring, blocks that appear only by chance, and swaps.

chance.description: Blocks that are there only by chance (minecraft:skeleton_skull: 0.5, half the time).

propertyNames.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

chance.title: Chance

mirror.description: True: the builder may mirror the piece (a pair of spots mirrored across the room gets the piece mirrored). Leave it false for a piece with writing or an asymmetric story.
mirror.title: Mirror

swaps.description: Blocks that may become another (minecraft:barrel: {to: ..., chance: 0.3}).

propertyNames.description: Namespaced id, e.g. minecraft:stone. Validated against the ID universe.

swaps.title: Swaps

VariantsDef.title: VariantsDef

description:
Where a set piece fits and where it may appear. The template next to it holds the blocks, built as the mask
shows them (the wall side to the north).

builds_walls.description: True: the piece brings its own W cells (its template holds them), so it needs free space in front of a flat wall there, not an existing niche.
builds_walls.title: Builds Walls

height.description: The piece's height above the floor, its template's too.
height.title: Height

id.description: Lowercase snake_case id; becomes realmforge:<id>. Must equal the file name.
id.title: Id

mask.description: Top view, one character per cell separated by single spaces, the first row the wall side: W wall, . the piece, _ clearance that stays walkable, ? anything.
mask.title: Mask

roles.description: The room roles it may appear in (default: hallway and combat; a treasure room, a boss's room and the entrance only take pieces that name them).
roles.title: Roles

source.description: The workshop jig's save it was imported from (realmforge_qa:set_piece/<mask>_<n>), written by rf set-pieces import, so --from-world skips it next time.
source.title: Source

tags.description: What the piece is (storage, prison, crypt, shrine, ...); dungeon types pick by tag.
tags.title: Tags

walls.description: What the W cells may be in a generated room: theme roles (wall: the wall's base, body, patches and cornice; pillar, ...) or block ids. An imported room's blocks have no roles: any full block there counts for a role.
walls.title: Walls

weight.description: How often it is picked among the pieces that fit.
weight.title: Weight

title: SetPieceDef
